name: io.github.ykarapazar/fontes
title: Fontes
description: Live case law and legislation from court and government sites in 125 jurisdictions; past laws too.

environmentVariables.name: WLM_FR_PISTE_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: France only: client ID of a free PISTE app subscribed to Judilibre and Légifrance. France is off without it.

environmentVariables.name: WLM_FR_PISTE_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: France only: client secret of the same PISTE app.

environmentVariables.name: WLM_US_GOVINFO_KEY
environmentVariables.description: United States only: free api.data.gov key for case-law search (without it, about 10 searches a day).

environmentVariables.name: WLM_US_COURTLISTENER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: US state courts only: your own free CourtListener API token (unofficial source, Free Law Project). Off without it.
